title: VSC draft compatibility, as implemented by @bsv/vsc
description: The catalogue entry for the exchange profile spec/vsc-profile.md defines and packages/vsc implements: a documented subset of the Verifiable Supply Chain Community Group drafts at a pinned revision, with an owned context, genuine Ed25519Signature2020 and bbs-2023 proofs, authenticated status, scoped authority and custody graph validation. Not W3C certification and not full upstream conformance.
dataModel: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 with the VSC SEAL vocabulary under the owned context urn:bsv:vsc:context:0.1.0

artefacts.notes: Pinned by revision; the ledger records it as a public source.
The referenced context returns 404 at the pinned revision; the owned context below is served instead and no bytes are invented under a W3C URL.

proofSuites.keyRule: An Ed25519 verification method authorised for assertion in the issuer's DID document; never the native BRC wallet or curve.
A BLS12-381 multikey authorised for assertion; base and request-bound derived proofs.
proofSuites.notes: The derivation API is a primitive; the caller authorises each optional disclosure pointer, and holder authentication is separate.

anchoring.bytesCommitted: the exact UTF-8 bytes of the complete issued credential including its Data Integrity proof
anchoring.subjectRule: one signed product identifier; the attestation id is not a product id

nativeEvidenceExtension.notes: An application token reference is signed within the urn:bsv:dpp:vocab:passport-binding:1 extension the registry already reads; the native evidence extension is the general form.

mappings.externalEvent: no automatic SEAL; a SEAL needs the actual event vector, status, authority and custody inputs
no automatic SEAL; a control transfer may have no lossless physical mapping

storage.nativeClaim: the signed dpp-lifecycle-v1 object, when the event has one
storage.originalSecured: the exact credential string as issued
storage.projection: a derived disclosure, verified with its own suite and request binding, never compared to the anchored full bytes

unsupported.reason: The upstream context is unavailable at the pinned revision; the owned context is explicit.
No executable suite exists at the pinned revision.
The HTTPS presentation protocol and holder authentication are not implemented.
Object DIDs may be carried; tag authentication and physical binding are separate capabilities.

sourceRefs.name: VSC Core draft
sourceRefs.use: The SEAL, custody and correction rules selected.

sourceRefs.name: VSC Requirements draft
sourceRefs.use: Takes precedence where Core defers to it.
